company.name: PromptLoop
company.shortDescription: PromptLoop enables users to build spreadsheet models powered by Artificial Intelligence.
company.description:
PromptLoop enables users to build spreadsheet models powered by Artificial Intelligence. Users can use PromptLoop in Google Sheets and Excel to create spreadsheet models that modify, extract, or summarize any text using their AI models.

PromptLoop is headquartered in San Francisco, California and was founded in 2021.
